title: Travel Guide POI Feature Properties
description: JSON Schema for GeoJSON Feature properties in alx/travel-guide. All POI features must satisfy this schema.

category.description: Place type — used for icon and filter

notes.description: Human-readable description shown on the POI card

phone.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. +66 80 305 1585

coord_source.description: How coordinates were obtained. 'google_maps_pin' = from a Maps share link; 'nominatim' = OSM geocoder; 'research' = cross-referenced from web sources; 'estimated' = approximate, needs verification; 'on_site_gps' = recorded on location.

coord_accuracy.description: Confidence in coordinate accuracy. 'high' = within ~10 m; 'medium' = within ~50 m; 'low' = rough area only, needs improvement.
